items.title: [Bug]: Unable to flash M5Stack Core2
items.body:
### Category

Hardware Compatibility

### Hardware

Other

### Firmware Version

N/A

### Description

I'm new to Meshtastic, so bear with me here.

I have a [M5Stack Core2](https://shop.m5stack.com/collections/m5-controllers/products/m5stack-core2-esp32-iot-development-kit). I saw a variant [here](https://github.com/meshtastic/firmware/tree/master/variants/m5stack_core) and also found [this](https://github.com/meshtastic/firmware/blob/666a1f3401b2da2ff9facf6c0227cd2622777bea/src/mesh/generated/meshtastic/mesh.pb.h#L86), so I figured I could flash it. I'm running Arch Linux and it shows up under `/dev/ttyACM0`.

```
> esptool.py --port /dev/ttyACM0 chip_id
esptool.py v4.5.1
Serial port /dev/ttyACM0
Connecting....
Detecting chip type... Unsupported detection protocol, switching and trying again...
Connecting....
Detecting chip type... ESP32
Chip is ESP32-D0WDQ6-V3 (revision v3.0)
Features: WiFi, BT, Dual Core, 240MHz, VRef calibration in efuse, Coding Scheme None
Crystal is 40MHz
MAC: 30:c6:f7:25:ef:9c
Uploading stub...
Running stub...
Stub running...
Warning: ESP32 has no Chip ID. Reading MAC instead.
MAC: 30:c6:f7:25:ef:9c
Hard resetting via RTS pin...
```

I cloned this repo, built the firmware according to [these](https://meshtastic.org/docs/development/firmware/build) instructions, but had to change the [port](https://github.com/meshtastic/firmware/blob/666a1f3401b2da2ff9facf6c0227cd2622777bea/variants/m5stack_core/platformio.ini#L5-L6) from `COM8` to `/dev/ttyACM0`. I then tried to flash as per the instructions.  Below is the output.

```
 *  Executing task: platformio run --target upload --environment m5stack-core
